name: claude-code
description: Hook entries for Claude Code, each calling `urzua harness hook claude-code <event>`: the editor hook (Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and file-writing MCP tools), which also refuses an agent's move to an accepting status and its write to a protected path, the post-command check (Bash), the session-start readiness check, and a drafting command for every record type with /amend, /repin, /reverify and /done. Nothing executable is installed in the repository.
